
== CreateWebsite with a copy
steps: Create Unix user | Copy databases | Pull and check image signature | Start container in gVisor | Configure edge proxy | Get TLS certificate
long: true
$ install -d -m 0711 $DIR/homes $DIR/sites
$ install -d -m 0711 $DIR/homes $DIR/sites
$ chmod 0700 $DIR/homes/staging_ab12
$ install -d -o root -g staging_ab12 -m 0750 $DIR/sites/staging_ab12
$ install -d -o staging_ab12 -g staging_ab12 -m 0750 $DIR/sites/staging_ab12/app
$ loginctl enable-linger staging_ab12
$ runuser -u staging_ab12 -- mkdir -p -m 0750 $DIR/sites/staging_ab12/app/public
$ systemctl start user@20001.service
$ runuser -u acme_x7k2 -- tar --create --file=- --directory=$DIR/sites/acme_x7k2/app -- . | runuser -u staging_ab12 -- tar --extract --file=- --directory=$DIR/sites/staging_ab12/app --no-same-owner --preserve-permissions
$ ip address replace 169.254.80.1/20 dev lo
$ systemctl daemon-reload
$ install -d -o root -g root -m 0711 $DIR/cf-db $DIR/cf-db/servers $DIR/cf-db/homes
$ chmod 0700 $DIR/cf-db/homes/db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1
$ loginctl enable-linger db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1
$ systemctl start user@10001.service
$ install -d -o root -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -m 0750 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1
$ install -d -o root -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -m 0750 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1/disk
$ install -d -o db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -m 0700 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1/disk/data
$ chown root:db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1/mariadb.env
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman image exists ghcr.io/cloudfactory/mariadb:latest
$ systemctl --user --machine=db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1@ daemon-reload
$ systemctl --user --machine=db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1@ restart cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1.service
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb-admin --protocol=tcp --host=127.0.0.1 --port=3306 --connect-timeout=5 ping
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | SELECT 1;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | SHOW DATABASES LIKE 'staging\\_ab12\\_shop';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | CREATE DATABASE `staging_ab12_shop` CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'cfdefiner_RANDOM'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'HEX24';
  | ALTER USER 'cfdefiner_RANDOM'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'HEX24' ACCOUNT UNLOCK;
  | GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON `staging\_ab12\_shop`.* TO 'cfdefiner_RANDOM'@'localhost';
$ chown db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 $DIR/secrets/env-RANDOM
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i --env-file $DIR/secrets/env-RANDOM cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --sandbox --user=cfdefiner_RANDOM --batch staging_ab12_shop
  | SELECT 1;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS `staging_ab12_shop`;
  | CREATE DATABASE `staging_ab12_shop` CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb-dump --user=root --single-transaction --routines --events acme_x7k2_shop
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i --env-file $DIR/secrets/env-RANDOM cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --sandbox --user=cfdefiner_RANDOM --batch staging_ab12_shop
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | ALTER USER IF EXISTS 'cfdefiner_RANDOM'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'HEX24' ACCOUNT LOCK;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | SELECT Host FROM mysql.user WHERE User = 'staging_ab12_app';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | SELECT 1 FROM mysql.user WHERE User = 'staging_ab12_app';
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | CREATE USER 'staging_ab12_app'@'169.254.80.1' IDENTIFIED BY 'Abcdefgh12345678' REQUIRE NONE WITH MAX_USER_CONNECTIONS 100;
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10001 podman exec -i cf-mariadb-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d1 mariadb --user=root --batch --skip-column-names
  | GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON `staging\_ab12\_shop`.* TO 'staging_ab12_app'@'169.254.80.1';
$ runuser -u staging_ab12 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/20001 podman pull --quiet ghcr.io/cloudfactory/frankenphp-php8.4:8.4.0-1
$ systemctl --user --machine=staging_ab12@ daemon-reload
$ systemctl --user --machine=staging_ab12@ restart cf-staging_ab12.service
result dnsPointsHere: true
result port: 20000
